leitura_do_criterio_texto: constant, valid: Q in [0.5; 2] AND coverage >= 0.80 in >= 12 of the 16 cells -> REINFORCES: the text provides the procedure (standard error of one split draw from the test blocks) within the reporting rule. Coverage < 0.60 in >= 8 cells -> DELIMITS: the text says that the dispersion across blocks of a single split draw under- or overestimates the drift by the median factor of Q, and the reporting rule becomes repeating split draws. In between: descriptive, with Q and coverage.
previsao_texto: the estimator captures the order of magnitude (Q between 0.5 and 2) in the population 'todos' (all nodes); in 'validos' (valid nodes), with few blocks containing valid nodes, it tends to underestimate.

definicoes.Err: sum_B S_B / M on the test set of the split draw (MAE of the population; equal to the mae of script 2.1)
definicoes.Q: mean of v over split draws with k >= 2 / empirical variance (ddof=1) of Err across split draws
definicoes.cobertura: fraction of split draws with defined v in which |Err - mean(Err)| <= 2 sqrt(v)
definicoes.leitura_A: empirical variance and mean of Err over all split draws with defined Err (M > 0) [primary]
definicoes.leitura_B: empirical variance and mean of Err over split draws with defined v (k >= 2)
definicoes.N_ocupados: 10 km blocks with >= 1 node in the cell [primary]
definicoes.N_bbox: cells of the bounding rectangle of the 10 km grid

interpretacao: NOT done in this artifact (outside the pipeline scope)
